model.name: pyannote/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM
model.runtime: pyannote.audio 4.0.7 with torch 2.14.1, local model cache, 16 kHz mono, centre crops of 1.0–6.0 s per cue

profile.basis: the dominant voice of each solo talk with local audio, combined into one consensus vector
profile.note: The profile is a voiceprint; it stays with the maintainer and only its hash is recorded here.

speech_acts.unclassified: a unit the model did not classify keeps no speaker label

reviewed_excerpts_of_yuzheng.note: Measured on the values-conversation recordings with the same thresholds; the one other is a guest's backchannel that the text match placed next to his quote.

evaluation.maintainer_review: Programmes where the voice evidence disagreed with the catalog type, or no voice could be confirmed as Yuzheng, were held back for the maintainer to confirm by ear and are not labelled here until confirmed.

speech_acts_on_reviewed_units_hNkglVeOLK.note: Both are a guest describing other people's attitudes, labelled statement; such guest lines are never Yuzheng's basis.

thresholds.guest_named_when: the catalog lists exactly one person for the programme and exactly one other voice was found
